purpose: Oversized MV-inspired persistent NPC visual library for the full Plushbound Legends world.
productionRule: Favor reusable component depth without cloning persistent identities. Every named persistent NPC receives a stable visual recipe.

ageBands.visualRule: short child proportions; playful readable silhouette; age-appropriate clothing
child proportions distinct from teens; school, errand and festival variants
distinct adolescent silhouette; never simple adult sprite scaling
broad profession and regional body-language variety
posture, hair and clothing variation without caricature

childNpcPolicy.safety: Children use age-appropriate designs and are never derived from adult fan-service silhouettes or clothing.

uniqueCanonCharacters.assetRule: unique sprite, portrait expression sheet, field variants and formal/casual wardrobe; never genericized
